exposure: Transvaginal NOTES (Natural Orifice Transluminal Endoscopic Surgery)
cohort: 76 women of reproductive age (≤ 45 years) who underwent transvaginal NOTES
finding: Transvaginal NOTES did not have a negative impact on conception, pregnancy, or delivery outcomes compared to the general population.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal birth (58.8%) and cesarean section (41.2%) after transvaginal NOTES was similar to the general population.
